88631.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in the busiest location (workplace) you can reach: the one with the most invoices and clocked time, so every tile has real work to do.
  3. You have a stopwatch or a phone timer ready.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: on the Dashboard, Sales by Customer (Last 12 Months) and Technician Utilization show figures; pick the location where they are largest. If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.

88643.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in a location (workplace) with several months of invoice history (many customers, invoices going back more than a year). At Risk needs old invoices, which cannot be back-dated by hand.
  3. Customer W: in the At Risk table (window 120 Days), a customer with Lifetime Invoices 2 or more, whose newest invoice you will make and then undo. You have written down W's Last Invoice Date.
  4. Customer X: a customer whose only invoice is more than 12 months old (Lifetime Invoices 1, so Revenue (12 Mo) is $0.00).
  5. Customer Y: a customer with 2 or more invoices, all more than 12 months old.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: the At Risk Customers tile on 120 Days shows a number above 0, and View details lists customers with Last Invoice Dates spread over the last months. If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
  • For 3: Dashboard > At Risk Customers on 120 Days > View details: the table shows Customer, Last Invoice Date, Lifetime Invoices and Revenue (12 Mo).
  • For 4 and 5: Customers > the customer > Invoices tab (turn Open only off) shows each invoice's date.
88643.custom_steps:
1. On the At Risk Customers tile click the window pill and choose 120 Days. Write down the headline and count the table rows.
  2. Look for customer X in the table.
  3. Look for customer Y in the table.
  4. Read down the table and check every row: Lifetime Invoices is 2 or more, or Revenue (12 Mo) is above $0.00.
  5. Window edge: on the window pill try each of 30, 60, 90, 120 and 180 Days, and look for a customer whose Last Invoice Date is exactly that many days before today (count calendar days, e.g. Jun 9, 2026 to Oct 7, 2026 = 120 days) and one at one day fewer. If the Create Invoice step on a work order lets you choose the invoice date, you may make such invoices instead.
  6. Make a new invoice today for customer W: Work Orders > Create Work Order > W and its asset > Save; in New Line one labor line (e.g. Labor Rate EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1), tick Line Approved > Save & Close; Story > Update; Complete (finish any Missing Details window); Mark Reviewed; Finance > Create Invoice (close the New Customer Payment window without paying).
  7. Click Dashboard, set the window to 120 Days and write down the headline. Look for W in the table.
  8. Click Work Orders, open the work order you just invoiced, Finance tab > the invoice's three dots > Reverse > confirm.
  9. Click Dashboard, set the window to 120 Days, write down the headline and find W's row.

  3. You know how to set a custom range on the Revenue tile: click its range pill, click a start day and an end day in the calendar, check the "Range: N days" readout at the bottom, then click Apply.

Check: the Revenue tile shows an amount above $0.00 on Last Year and on This Year; then set the pill back to its default (the dashboard remembers your choices). If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.

88649.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in a location (workplace) with several advisors and technicians and at least two months of invoices and clocked time.
  3. Chart tooltips show whole percentages (e.g. 117%) while the reports show two decimals: compare after rounding the report figure to a whole number.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: Billing Efficiency and Technician Efficiency set to Last 12 Months > View details: the Advisor filter and the Technician filter each list at least two names; then set the pill back to its default (the dashboard remembers your choices). If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
88649.custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top menu.
  2. On Billing Efficiency set the range pill to Last 12 Months and click View details.
  3. In the chart's Advisor filter choose one advisor (any advisor in the list).
  4. Hover the chart point for last month and write down that advisor's percentage and ELR.
  5. Click Reports > Advisor Analysis, choose the same advisor in the Advisor filter and set the Date control to Last month. Write down the Totals row Billing Efficiency and ELR.
  6. Back on the Dashboard, set Technician Efficiency to Last 12 Months, click View details, and in the Technician filter keep only two technicians (any two).
  7. Hover last month's point and write down each technician's percentage.
  8. Click Reports > Technician Efficiency, Invoiced tab, Date: Last month, and write down those two technicians' Efficiency.
  9. Repeat steps 6 to 8 on Technician Utilization, comparing with the Technician Utilization report with the same two technicians chosen in its Technician filter.
  10. On Reports > Advisor Analysis keep the same advisor chosen, set the Date control to This year, and hover last month's point on the chart above the table.
  11. On the Dashboard set Billing Efficiency to This Year with the same advisor chosen and hover last month's point.

88650.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in a location (workplace) with invoices and clocked time this month.
  3. You run this case before the last day of the month, so This Month is not finished yet.
  4. If a total differs only in the last decimal place (0.01) because rows are rounded, mark the case Blocked and write both numbers in the comment: the specification does not cover rounding of row sums.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: on the Dashboard, Revenue on This Month is above $0.00 and Technician Efficiency on This Month shows a percentage (not -). If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
